title: Paul's Prayer for His Return and Holiness
description: Paul expresses his deep gratitude to God for the church in Thessalonica and earnestly prays to see them again to complete what is lacking in their faith. He asks that God and the Lord Jesus will direct their hearts, and that they may grow and overflow with love for one another and for all people. He also prays that the Lord will strengthen their hearts so that they may stand blameless in holiness at the coming of Jesus with all his saints.
